plain: Splitting the data into K parts, fitting on all but one, scoring on the part left out, and rotating, so no item both builds and grades the result.
eli5: Taking turns: each friend sits out one round to be the judge, so nobody grades their own work.
technical: Partition the data into K folds; for each fold, fit on the other K−1 and evaluate on it; average the K scores to estimate out-of-sample performance or choose a setting (here, a layer) without fitting to the test items.
